name: SatisfyingOverlay
teaser:
Because nothing calms you down like a rug being pressure-washed…
...while you're bleeding out in Interchange.
description_html:
This mod adds configurable video-overlay directly into your SPT raids.

Pure visual dopamine, perfect for tactical vibing mid-fight.

🧠 Features

  • 🎥 Plays videos during raids
    • Supports adding up to 10 videos at the same time!!
  • ⚙️ Fully separate configurable for each video-player:
    • Position (X/Y)
    • Scale (Width/Height)
    • Transparency
    • Audio toggle
    • Setup video from folder mod

🔧 Installation:

Install KmyTarkovApi 1.4.0 or later, You MUST install it

Extract BepInEx folder from 7z to Game Root directory. Profit!

How to use

🔹How do add my videos?

  • Put your .mp4 videos in this folder:
    BepInEx/plugins/SatisfyingOverlay/Videos
  • Start SPT
  • Press F12 to open configurator
  • Choose a new added video in dropdown

🔹Does this work outside of raids?

  • No. Videos only play during raids.

🔹Why is the weight of the archive large?

  • Because embedded with the mod 5 example videos:
    • Carpet cleaning
    • Kinetic sand cutting
    • Slime
    • Soap crush
    • Subway Surf gameplay

🔹Can videos play sound?

  • Yes! Turn on “AudioEnable” in settings video-slot Volume is linked to in-game music volume slider

🔹My video doesn’t show up!

  • Make sure it’s an .mp4 file.
  • Avoid weird characters in the name.
  • Re-encode the video by ffmpeg ffmpeg -i broken.mp4 -c:v libx264 -c:a aac fixed.mp4

Made by Katrin0522 aka Kat.

Idea sparked by pure overstimulation and a love for oddly satisfying TikToks.
